H2479.o: feminine from the same as H2478 (חַלְחוּל);

H2486.d: literal fora profaned thing; used (interj.) far be it!
H2486.o: or חָלִלָה; a directive from H2490 (חָלַל);
H2486.f: au sens propre une chose profanée ; employé (interj.) loin de là !

H2489.o: or חֵלְכָה; apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (figuratively) unhappy;

H2490.d: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute)
H2490.k: begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.
H2490.o: a primitive root (compare H2470 (חָלָה)); also  denominative (from H2485 (חָלִיל))
H2490.f: proprement, percer, c.-à-d. (par implication) blesser, dissoudre ; au figuré, profaner (une personne, un lieu ou une chose), violer (sa parole), commencer (comme par un « coin d'ouverture ») ; jouer (de la flûte)

H2491.f: transpercé (spécialement à mort) ; au figuré, souillé

H2492.d: properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream
H2492.k: (cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.
H2492.f: proprement, lier fermement, c.-à-d. (par implication) être (causativement rendre) dodu ; aussi (par le sens figuré du mutisme) rêver

H2493.o: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2492 (חָלַם);

H2495.o: from H2492 (חָלַם) (in the sense of insipidity);

H2496.o: probably from H2492 (חָלַם) (in the sense of hardness);

H2498.d: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
H2498.k: abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.
H2498.f: proprement, glisser au-delà, c.-à-d. (par implication) s'en aller en hâte, passer, pousser, percer ou changer
